name: Disneyland Maurice's Treats (Fantasyland) Cream Cheese/Chocolate Croissant or Cheddar Bagel Twist
whyItWorks: Right next to the Royal Hall in Fantasyland, Maurice's cart bakes soft twisted bread rolls and flaky croissants with zero seeds or roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chocolate Croissant or Cheddar Twist with a lactase tablet; if trying the famous Boysen-Apple Freeze, sip just a few spoonfuls slowly as it is a sweet apple-berry slush.
watchOuts: Contains dairy cheese/butter—take a lactase enzyme
